scope: actual check entry plus main/loop/export/resume on three CPU synthetic images

production_config.purpose: five complete train-only pilot epochs from fresh weights; learn an independent absolute E8M0 scale shared by the E2 modes, initialized once to the initial E4 scale x64; unchanged E4 source and exponent/mantissa bit truncation
production_config.weight_preprocess: original W32 G(W); detached mean(abs(W)), tanh/max normalization
production_config.activation_policy: original A32/ReLU in ALL THREE modes
production_config.mx_group_axis: flatten Cin*Kh*Kw within each Cout, zero-pad tail
production_config.mx_scale_policy: unchanged dynamic E4M3 source scale floor(log2(amax))-8; E2M3 and E2M1 share independent absolute E8M0 exponent round_half_up(phi); initialize once from initial E4 exponent+6, never recompute phi from E4; E8M0 finite exponents -127..127; reject nonfinite FP32 decode without clipping or wrap
production_config.mx_rounding: E4M3 source nearest ties-to-even; finite FP32 source, scalar subnormal flush; lower modes exact bit mappings without additional rounding
production_config.ste_policy: identity wrt G(W) all three modes; phi gradient ln(2)*sum_real_block(grad_q*q) from E2M3/E2M1; no normalization; no direct E4 phi gradient; source codes/scales detached; retain G(W) derivatives
production_config.numeric_kernel: FP32 F.conv2d; codec FP64 intermediates; not native low-bit kernels
production_config.fp32_decode_policy: reject overflow; exponents126/127 are valid E8M0 but not all E2 element codes remain finite in FP32
production_config.scale_gradient: ln(2)*sum_real_block(grad_q*q); accumulate E2M3 and E2M1 only
production_config.quantization_source: one current E4M3 encoding per MX layer and minibatch, shared across all three modes
production_config.exponent_mapping: s e3 e2 e1 e0 m2 m1 m0 -> s e3 e2 m2 m1 m0; target bias1; no bias compensation
production_config.mantissa_mapping: derived E2M3 uint8 codes >> 2; exact same per-block learned scale as E2M3
production_config.source_cache_policy: detached integer source, absolute lower scale and derived codes; phi version fixed within triplet; cached q saved for backward; cleared before Adam
production_config.loss: E4M3 hard CE + E2M3 soft CE from detached E4M3 + E2M1 soft CE from detached E2M3; T=1; gradients summed, no division by 3
production_config.batchnorm_policy: normal training updates of three mode banks E4M3=8,E2M3=32,E2M1=4; parameters and running stats learn per mode; eval frozen; keys are storage IDs, all A32; banks1/2 unused
production_config.initialization_policy: fresh seed20261009; same untrained state as prior model construction; no warmstart
production_config.evaluation_policy: all three modes on complete official test after every epoch; hard CE for each
production_config.selection_policy: first strict maximum of E4M3/A32 official-test top1
production_config.reporting_policy: all three modes at epoch5 or actual final epoch and at the same E4M3-best checkpoint; compare only matched epochs against historical five-epoch references; no epoch100 accuracy claim
production_config.rng_policy: global streams as upstream; sequential dropout draws per mode; saved at epoch boundaries
production_config.checkpoint_policy: immutable FP32 training state per epoch and selected best/last copies
production_config.export_policy: one E4M3 source plus one independent absolute E8M0 lower scale byte per group and BN auxiliary state; derive lower exports only from saved source codes and absolute lower scales; no MX masters or FP32 phi in compact exports; resume retains phi and Adam

check_entry_report.scope: actual main/check on CPU, test-only runtime and explicit CPU oracle substitution
check_entry_report.reason_for_test_dependency_inventory: isolated CPU validation venv contains no pip module
